tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

No decision on this project's version numbering scheme is currently recorded, so no scheme is stated here. This policy should be updated once a decision is made and recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It says that no version numbering scheme is currently recorded, and it names no scheme.

Muninn has no decision or standing rule on versioning. Its only related records are two one-word notes from separate earlier sessions, "calver" and "semver". Each was only acknowledged, with nothing decided, and they contradict each other. `muninn why` also reported that no record of trust 2 or higher answers the question. I therefore didn't treat either note as the project's choice.
